description: Find the right title when you only have a partial name or a rough description. Returns ranked {title, wikidata_id, description, summary_snippet}; ranking blends text relevance with monthly pageviews and follows redirects, so abbreviations land on the real article — "usa" returns United States, "jfk" returns John F. Kennedy, "apple" returns Apple Inc. rather than a disambiguation page. Searches every corpus at once unless you pass `corpus`. Follow up with lookup() for facts or article() for the text.

corpus.description: Restrict to one corpus. Omit to search all of them at once, which is usually what you want when you do not know where the answer is.

name: search
